Name: Out After Dark
Author: loshionbottle
Description:
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/xKJhVHX6/overview-better.png[/img][/url]
[font=Trebuchet MS]This mod is a continuation of my "After Dark" series! Though this modpack doesn't focus on a single character, it adds more stalker/yandere esque immersion in terms of the player's "death" events & some mail you get after you pass out.[/font]


[i][b][size=4][color=#e06666]POTENTIAL TRIGGER WARNINGS[/color][/size]
[/b][/i][font=Trebuchet MS]There's no explicit parts or smut mentioned in this pack! However, this is supposed to be creepy & you may or may not like what's offered here. Please view the following at your own topics and [b]DO NOT PLAY THIS PACK IF YOU ARE SENSITIVE TO ANY OF THE FOLLOWING[/b][/font]

[b][u]OVERALL
[/u][/b][font=Trebuchet MS]The figure's NPC is used in a few events. Its presence is supposed to be unsettling.

[b][u]SPECIFICALLY MENTIONS OF
[/u][/b]1. Drugging
2. CNC & Hints of Somnophilia (No explicit parts are mentioned, though you are kissed, your thigh/cheek/throat are touched, your ass is grabbed, & sometimes it's hinted that things would continue/more is touched if...) 
3. Overall stalker/yandere characters
4. There is an event that happens after marriage where your spouse will keep you locked on the farm for a day/refuse to let you leave.

[i][b][color=#e06666][size=3]IT IS ASSUMED THE FARMER GIVES CONSENT, PLEASE KEEP THAT IN MIND[/size][/color]

[/b][/i][/font]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/hxhBXTzw/faq-better.png[/img][/url]
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ea9999][i][b]What portrait mod are you using in the mod photos? [/b][/i][/color][/font][font=Trebuchet MS]
I use [/font][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16838]Rin's Portraits[/url]!

[b][i][color=#ea9999]Is this compatible with...?[/color][/i]
[/b]No, it's not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7493]Spouses React to Player 'Death'[/url] or any similar mods. There is no making them compatible at all. Otherwise, it should be good with any other mod. If you're noticing errors, then maybe let me know so I can make note of it.

Moreso, none of my mods are made with Polyamory in mind, though they should work fine* with them.
*There may be one or two times﻿ in this modpack where it's not compatible... but idk[/font]

[color=#ea9999][b][i]Can I translate to...?﻿[/i]
[/b][/color]Yes! I give you my full permission to translate to whatever language you're wanting! Just be sure to note me as the original author, please!

[b][i][color=#ea9999]What spouses are supported?[/color]
[/i][/b]This mod'll work for any spouse, however, there are only specific scenarios for the current vanilla bachelors as that's what I'm focusing on. I'll eventually add in more content for other spouses!



[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Rw6KfsD/requirements-better.png[/img][/url]
As well as Content Patcher, Generic Mod Config Menu and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29185]Shadows After Dark[/url], this mod needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23637]NPC Tokens[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642]Event Repeater[/url].



[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/TxzNZh6p/config-menu-better.png[/img][/url]
[u][b][color=#e06666]PLAYER CONFIGURATION[/color]
[/b][/u]  [b]﻿Player Pronouns: 
[/b][color=#ea9999]  [b]﻿CAUTION - These are DIFFERENT compared to Alex, Sam's, & Sebastian's pack
[/b]  ﻿If you use She/Her pronouns, PAY ATTENTION to where you're putting things. I did not make an error here. 
﻿For those confused/don't want to look here, you can always hover over "Player Pronouns x" and it will show an example for you.[/color]
      ﻿﻿There are 2 slots for you to input your pronouns:
[i]﻿  ﻿  ﻿﻿- Player Pronouns 1: Would typically be something similar to "They", "She", "He".[/i]
[i]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 2: Would typically be something similar to "Their", "Her", "His".[/i]
﻿  ﻿  [i]﻿﻿﻿- Player Pronouns 3: Would typically be something similar to "Them", "Her", "Him".
[/i][i]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 4: Would typically be something similar to "They're", "She's", "He's".[/i]

﻿[b]Death Consequences:[/b]
﻿  ﻿This [i]only[/i] turns off the consequences that occur when you get yourself killed (i.e. getting charged/items taken/etc).
﻿  ﻿  ﻿If you pass out, you will still have a chance to face consequences despite this config.
